mr.title: {name}: incoming change to "{title}"
mr.description:
This page and its counterpart in {name} both changed since the last sync, so nothing was overwritten. The external version is on this branch; review it against the current page and merge if it should win.

Source: {url}
mr.wikiDescription:
The repo wiki regenerated this page from {name} because the code it describes changed. Nothing on the page has changed yet: review the new version on this branch and merge it to publish.

Generated from commit {commit} (unit {unit}).
Source: {url}

A newer regeneration of this page closes this merge request and opens its own.

warning.pushUnsupported: {kind} cannot publish back, so this page was left alone.
warning.documentMissing: The linked page no longer exists; the link was removed.
warning.conflict: Both sides changed — a merge request was opened instead of overwriting.
warning.orphan: Reached by listing the space, not by walking the tree - its parent may not be visible to this connector.
warning.orphansFound: {count} page(s) were not reachable through the page tree and were added at the top level.
warning.discoveryStopped: The page tree walk was stopped by request; {count} branch(es) were left unread.
warning.reRooted: Filed at the connector's destination: the page above this one has not been imported.

codebase.noOwner: This connector has no owner to bill, so the pages were written from the extracted facts only.
codebase.aiDisabled: No AI provider is configured, so the pages contain the extracted facts only.
codebase.budget: The workspace AI budget is exhausted, so the pages contain the extracted facts only.
codebase.narrationFailed: Writing the summary failed, so this page contains the extracted facts only.
codebase.oversize: {count} file(s) were too large to read and were skipped.
codebase.unparsed: {count} file(s) in this module could not be parsed and were skipped.

codebase.modulesOmitted: {count} module(s) beyond the configured limit are not documented. Raise the module limit to include them.
codebase.indexFailed: The code-usage index could not be updated, so it still describes the previous pull: {error}

apiSpec.bundled: Relative $ref files were bundled into this one document.
apiSpec.remote: {ref} (in {file}) points outside the repository and was not fetched; the spec cannot be imported until it is bundled or removed.

apiSpec.outside: {ref} (in {file}) climbs out of the repository and was not followed.

warning.trashedUpstream: Moved to the bin in the source. The page here is kept; restoring the file there updates this page again.
warning.goneUpstream: No longer visible to this connector — deleted, unshared, or moved out of its folder. The page here is kept.
warning.removedFound: {count} linked page(s) left the source's view since the last sync. Their pages were kept and are listed in this run.
